proposal.hypothesis: Caching each 4096-wide row once as float4 in threadgroup memory and reusing it for exp and scaling gives one global read, one exp per element, and fast SIMD reductions, beating the three-pass global-memory incumbent.
Register-resident float4 rows with one 512-thread group per row remove threadgroup-buffer round trips and extra passes, improving large softmax speed.
One 256-thread threadgroup per row with coalesced strided loads and threadgroup tree reductions for max and sum should efficiently softmax 128x4096 rows.
